thread:
Maya Patel: Quick sync We need a compact GA handoff checklist covering SLA enforcement, docs, support routing, monitoring retention, pricing edge-cases. Who can own gaps?

Devon Chu: I'll own SLA playbook. Question: do we enforce with automatic fallbacks or just alerts?

Ravi Kapoor: Billing ops: key gaps = how fallback billing works, token rounding for streaming, and auto-credit rules when we miss p99.

Jen Torres: Monitoring: infra wants 90d traces; product wants 30d aggregates. Can we split retention by persona?

Priya (Legal): Two musts: (1) contract SLA remediations must map to Console metrics; (2) add opt-in limited retention checkbox for GDPR. Can't sign GA wording until mapped.

Devon Chu: Proposed SLOs for hosted: p50 <100ms, p95 <250ms, p99 <600ms. Fallback policy should aim to preserve p95. Will include metric->contract mapping.

Maya Patel: Fallback policy: same-model family lower-capacity -> regional fallback -> queued degrade w/ customer-visible header. Document + runbook required.

Ravi Kapoor: Billing proposal: charge based on model actually served; streaming rounding per 100-token chunk; on fallback bill at lower rate and emit billing event for customer report. Need finance signoff.

Jen Torres: Retention compromise: infra keeps 90d raw traces; product sees 30d aggregated metrics; add redaction rules for sensitive fields.

Priya (Legal): Redaction OK. For limited retention opt-in we need UI consent flow + DPA flag. Add to GA checklist.

Deploy Bot: Canary plan posted: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h holds. Auto-rollback if error-rate > 1.5x baseline.

Maya Patel: Add runbook snippets for auto and manual rollback and customer comms templates for degraded mode.

Devon Chu: Runbook snippet I'll add to PR: ```
# Auto-rollback trigger
if error_rate > baseline * 1.5 for 15m -> rollback and page oncall
```

Ravi Kapoor: For credits: propose automated credit line applied to next invoice for customers on contract; manual CS only if opt-out. Need audit trail for legal/finance.

Priya (Legal): Contracts must permit automated credits; finance to confirm thresholds. Include audit trail requirement.

Jen Torres: Monitoring alerting: infra team gets raw alerts (90d); product gets aggregated signals (30d). Add quality-monitoring that runs prompt-suite tests and alerts regressions.

Maya Patel: Action items: Devon  SLA + runbook + metric-contract map; Jen  retention + quality-monitor spec; Ravi  billing fallback + credit automation spec; Priya  contract flag + DPA wording; Ops/DevEx  customer degraded-mode templates + support routing. PRs due EOD Wed.

Devon Chu: I'll open /docs/ga-handoff PR with SLA table + runbook today.

Ravi Kapoor: Drafting billing flow and finance stub.

Jen Torres: Pushing monitoring spec and retention toggle into repo.

Priya (Legal): Circulating contract + DPA patch for review.

Maya Patel: Final ask: add an "observability cost" line to pricing docs so customers can see retention tradeoffs. Review PRs Thurs triage. :thumbsup:
